Source: A 29-year-old woman comes to the emergency department complaining of painful genital ulcers that have been present for 4 days as well as low-grade fever and malaise.
Physical examination reveals multiple clustered vesicles and shallow ulcers in the vulvar region.
She denies any recent travel, new sexual partners, or antibiotic use.
A Tzanck smear shows multinucleated giant cells.
